title: Hundreds of delays, dozens of cancellations at Logan amid heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Logan Airport experienced 493 flight delays and 73 cancellations due to heavy rain, according to FlightAware.
JetBlue had the most delays at Logan with 110 flights, followed by Republic Airways with 100 delayed flights.
Boston expected 2-3 inches of rain by Thursday morning, while Worcester Regional Airport set a daily record with 2.64 inches.

title: Which trade chips could Red Sox use to acquire another impact bat?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox seek an impact bat before MLB's trade deadline, considering trade deals involving prospects.
Top prospect Franklin Arias and young player Marcelo Mayer are potential trade chips for Boston.
Boston's pitching talents like Payton Tolle and Jake Bennett may also feature in trade discussions.

title: Wellfleet police release plea for help from public in 2025 homicide
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Timothy Duval Jr., a 24-year-old Army veteran, was fatally struck by a vehicle in Wellfleet on May 25, 2025.
Wellfleet Police and Cape and Islands DA's Office are requesting public assistance in the 2025 homicide investigation.
Authorities urge anyone with information to contact Wellfleet Police Detective Jack Poska at 508-349-2100.

title: New report sheds light on Curtis Mead’s potential return to Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Curtis Mead won't need surgery for his broken wrist sustained during Boston debut, potential return in 6-8 weeks.
Mead was acquired from the Nationals and placed on the injured list after being hit by a pitch.
Red Sox rank 29th in MLB for home runs; Mead's injury complicates efforts to boost lineup power.

title: Hennessy’s in downtown Boston has closed, plans to transfer liquor license to new Seaport restaurant
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Hennessy's Bar in downtown Boston closed; the bar operated for nearly 30 years near Quincy Market.
The bar plans to transfer its liquor license to Bar 23, opening next year in the Seaport area.
Bar 23 is a 75-seat restaurant, a smaller version of Grill 23, focusing on a steak menu.

title: Framingham remote Logan terminal will be extended through March
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: The Framingham remote Logan terminal pilot program is extended through March 2026 after serving 10,000 passengers since June.
Massport's terminal allows passengers to complete TSA screening before airport arrival, used by Delta and JetBlue flyers from 5:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Future plans include expanding remote terminals to other locations and adding more airlines, enhancing operational efficiency and amenities.

title: Sonny Gray reportedly interested in signing extension with Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Sonny Gray has expressed interest in a contract extension with the Boston Red Sox.
Gray, currently 12-2 with a 2.78 ERA, has been Boston's most reliable starting pitcher this season.
Boston's improved performance in July has shifted Gray from trade candidate to potential long-term signing.

title: Teen driver killed, 4 others hospitalized in stolen SUV crash in Abington
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 17-year-old driver died in a stolen SUV crash on Washington St. in Abington, police said.
Four teenagers aged 14 to 17 were hospitalized with life-threatening injuries after the car hit a tree.
Police were attempting to stop the stolen Hyundai Santa Fe when the crash occurred, authorities reported.

title: Celtics ‘expressed interest’ in LeBron James in free agency before he joined 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Celtics showed interest in LeBron James during free agency, but he signed with the Philadelphia 76ers.
LeBron James, 41, joins a 76ers team with Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid, and Tyrese Maxey on a veteran's minimum deal.
James prioritizes championship contention with the 76ers and aims to compete for another title before ending his career.

title: Parts of Mass. under flash flood warning as state sees heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Parts of Massachusetts, including Springfield and Chicopee, under flash flood warning until 6 p.m. Wednesday.
Berkshire County faces a flood warning until 5:45 p.m. with rainfall totals up to 7 inches expected.
Central and Western Massachusetts, Eastern Rhode Island, and Connecticut are under flood watch until 8 p.m.
